sloka: मम दुह्खम् इदम् पुत्र भूयः समुपजायते ।शपथैः शपमानो हि प्राणान् उपरुणत्सि मे ॥२-७५-६१॥
transliteration: mama duhkham idam putra bhūyaḥ samupajāyate ।śapathaiḥ śapamāno hi prāṇān uparuṇatsi me ॥2-75-61॥

translations.english: O son by swearing on oaths, you are choking the very breath of my life and my suffering has grown still more.
